title: Full-Stack Engineer (Frontend-Leaning) - CreativeMusic
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

Music is becoming a first-class part of ElevenLabs Creative. You’ll own the UI that lets creators make it, working closely with Research to turn new music models into products people use the next day.

The open question is what the best interface for AI music creation looks like. Creators come for video, dubbing or ads, and music is part of that flow. Making a song from scratch, scoring a video and localising a track into other languages each need a different flow. You’ll form a view on the right experience, build it end to end, and make it easy to adopt each new model as it lands.

You’ll take an ambiguous problem, decompose it, and carry it through legal, design, engineering and launch with Growth. You’ll work in a small, high-ownership team across product, research and go-to-market.

Requirements 

- Strong Frontend experience: you’ve shipped complex, production UIs (React/TypeScript or equivalent) and are comfortable on the backend when the work needs it

- You’ve owned ambiguous, zero-to-one product work from problem definition to launch, without a PM or a prescriptive backlog

- You’ve worked closely with designers (Figma) and have taste and opinions about UX

- You’ve worked across functions such as legal, safety, growth and design to ship, and keep stakeholders updated without prompting

- You weigh trade-offs and make pragmatic decisions with no single right answer, and build so that new models can be swapped in as they land

Bonus 

- Music, audio or creative-tools experience, or music as a hobby (singing, an instrument, production)

- Experience building media-heavy interfaces such as audio, video or timeline editors

- Experience working with ML models or research teams

Location 

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or on the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in Central European timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London, New York and Warsaw.

Our Engineering team

Our stack

title: Staff Full Stack Engineer
description:
About Allica Bank 

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description 

Technology sits at the centre of Allica. We design and build the platforms that power the bank, working closely with every part of the business to deliver real impact for customers. Our teams move quickly, focus on outcomes, and take ownership from concept through to delivery. We solve complex problems, modernise processes, and enable the business to scale with confidence.

What makes us different is the level of influence and autonomy engineers have. We work without the weight of legacy systems, which means we can focus on building for the future. Everyone contributes ideas and helps shape how we operate, and roles evolve as the organisation grows. This is a place for people who want to have a tangible impact and do their best work in a modern, collaborative environment.

Role Description 

The Staff Full Stack Engineer is responsible for setting technical direction across multiple squads, typically overseeing 2–3 squads and line-managing 3–5 Full Stack Engineers. The role exists to shape architecture, ensure the success of these squads, and drive consistent, secure, and compliant delivery across Allica’s digital products.

You will use your expertise in Spring Boot microservices (Java/Kotlin) and modern web technologies (React/TypeScript) to define and evolve cross-squad patterns, shared tooling, and platform capabilities.

Our backend microservices are containerised and deployed to Azure Container Apps, and our web applications are deployed to Azure Static Web Apps; you will help define and uphold the standards that make these platforms robust, cost-effective, and easy to operate.

You will own key cross-cutting concerns such as authentication, observability, performance, accessibility, and regulatory compliance, ensuring our systems meet the standards expected of a UK bank.

You are hands-on: you design and review architectures, pair with engineers, and contribute code to high-impact initiatives.

You work closely with Product, Design and other engineering leaders to align technical direction with business goals and to unblock delivery.

You drive the responsible adoption of GenAI and agentic engineering practices (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot), setting organisation-wide standards and measuring impact.

Success in this role is reflected in simpler architectures, improved delivery consistency and reliability, stronger engineering effectiveness, and the growth and performance of your direct reports and squads.

Principal Accountabilities 

Set and evolve cross-squad technical patterns and guardrails for:

- Backend services (Kotlin/Java Spring Boot microservices, REST/OpenAPI, messaging, integrations).

- Frontend architectures (React/TypeScript, shared design system, Nx, micro frontends where appropriate).

- Authentication/authorisation, API gateways and API governance (versioning, contracts, deprecation).

- Own platform-level technical initiatives that reduce complexity and duplication, including shared libraries, design system tokens, infrastructure templates, observability frameworks, and code/scaffolding templates.

- Define and maintain organisation-wide standards for performance, reliability, security, accessibility, and operational excellence, in partnership with Architecture, InfoSec, Risk, and Compliance.

- Establish and improve SLOs, error budget policies, and incident management practices across key services; lead post-incident reviews and drive follow-through on structural fixes.

- Lead cross-squad system design for complex initiatives, ensuring coherent architectures, well-managed dependencies, clear domain boundaries, and effective interactions between services and frontends.

- Shape and continuously improve cloud-native deployment patterns on Azure (Container Apps, Static Web Apps, networking, configuration, and scaling), working closely with Platform Engineering teams.

- Drive improvements to developer experience (CI/CD, local development workflows, test strategy, release processes) across multiple squads, leveraging GitHub, Azure DevOps and other approved tools.

Define and champion responsible AI-assisted engineering practices, including:

- Standards for using Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot and other approved GenAI tools.

- Expectations for review and validation of AI-generated code.

- Measurement and optimisation of productivity gains and quality improvements.

- Mentor and line-manage Senior Full Stack Engineers, supporting their growth in technical leadership, people leadership, and impact across squads.

- Foster a culture of learning and continuous improvement through communities of practice, architecture forums, and regular knowledge-sharing.

- Influence and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders (Product, Design, Operations, Risk, Compliance), aligning technical strategies with product and business roadmaps.

Personal Attributes & Experience 

- Extensive experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale using Spring Boot (Kotlin/Java) and modern web technologies (React/TypeScript).

- Proven track record of simplifying complex architectures and defining cross-team patterns and platforms in a multi-squad environment.

- Solid experience with containerised workloads and cloud platforms (Azure preferred; AWS or Google Cloud also valuable), including deployment, monitoring, and scaling of microservices and web applications.

- Deep understanding of secure coding practices (e.g. OWASP), privacy, auditability, and regulatory expectations in financial services or similarly regulated environments.

- Strong experience with observability, SLOs, incident management, and operational excellence (logging, tracing, metrics, dashboards, on-call practices).

- Strong understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices, ideally using GiHub actions or Azure DevOps Pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and automated testing at multiple levels.

- Experience designing and governing APIs at scale (REST, OpenAPI, API gateways, versioning, backwards compatibility, service contracts).

- Demonstrated ability to lead technical programmes or initiatives that span multiple teams and systems, delivering measurable improvements to reliability, performance, or developer productivity.

- Experience introducing and scaling the use of new tools and standards across organisations, including GenAI technologies (e.g. GitHub Copilot) with appropriate guardrails.

- Proven people leadership experience: line-managing senior engineers, coaching technical leaders, and building high-performing, inclusive teams.

- Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, communicate trade-offs clearly, and build consensus.

Working at Allica Bank

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

- Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.

- Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.

- Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.

- Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.

- Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.

- Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.

- Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.

- Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

- Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.

- Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.

- Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.

- Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.

- Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.

- Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.

- Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.

- Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

- DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.

- Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.

- GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.

- Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.

- Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.

- Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.

What we offer you

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.

- Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.

- Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.

- Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.

- Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.

- A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.

About Smartly

Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.

We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.

Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Direct experience with every technology listed here is less important than the judgment to learn, reason from first principles, and ship useful platform capabilities.

About Smartly 

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

Visit Smartly to learn more.

description:

Machine Learning Engineer IV – (Computer Vision) 

We’re looking for a Staff/Senior Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics to lead the design and scaling of face recognition systems in production. You’ll build and train models, and own ML systems end-to-end on AWS. The final job level for this role will be determined following the interview process.

What You’ll Do 

- Lead the design and development of computer vision systems for biometrics (face attributes, detection, quality, and recognition)

- Rigorous fairness analysis and benchmarking of biometric models across various datasets and operating conditions.

- Architect, train, and optimize models using PyTorch, Tensorflow, and/or JAX

- Production Engineering: Own the path to production. Optimize models for low-latency inference (quantization, distillation, TensorRT/ONNX) and manage deployment on AWS.

- Mentor ML engineers, conduct code/design reviews, and drive technical best practices across the Computer Vision team.

What We’re Looking For 

- Strong industry experience in Machine Learning, dedicated to Biometrics or Face Analysis.

- Deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics, especially face recognition.

- Fairness & Ethics: You understand the sources of algorithmic bias in Computer Vision and have practical experience measuring and mitigating disparate impact.

- Strong Engineering: Expert proficiency in Python (both machine learning and vision libraries such as Pillow, OpenCV, PyTorch, etc). You write clean, modular, production-ready code.

- Systems Architecture: Experience designing end-to-end ML pipelines (Data to Train to Deploy) and working with workflow orchestrators like Airflow.

- Cloud Native: Hands-on experience scaling training jobs on multi-GPU clusters and deploying services on AWS (SageMaker, EC2, EKS).

Nice to Have 

- Research Publications: Papers in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or FG related to face recognition, image quality assessment, or fairness.

- Large Scale Search: Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Faiss) and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.

- Familiarity with privacy, security, and compliance in biometric systems.

- Mobile/Edge Experience: Experience porting models to edge or mobile devices utilizing frameworks such as CoreML, LiteRT, and/or TFLite.

- Synthetic Data: Experience using GANs or diffusion models to generate synthetic faces for training.

- Strong communication skills.

title: QA Engineer (Anywhere in Europe)
description:
The Role We Need: 

PadSplit is hiring a QA Engineer to strengthen quality across our Marketplace pod, spanning Mobile (iOS/Android), Web, and backend Platform systems. As our product complexity increases, we need someone who can independently validate cross-platform user flows, reduce production risk, and increase release confidence through disciplined, hands-on testing.

The Person We Are Looking For: 

We’re looking for a proactive, technically fluent QA Engineer who thrives in a dynamic startup environment and takes ownership of product quality. You’re comfortable working across mobile, web, and backend systems, partnering closely with Engineering and Product to identify risk early, and prevent issues before they reach production.

Here’s What You’ll Do Day-To-Day:

- Test Strategy Ownership – Design and execute comprehensive test strategies across Mobile, Web, and backend services.

- End-to-End Validation – Validate complex user flows that span frontend interfaces and backend systems.

- API & Backend Testing – Perform API validation, data integrity checks, and business logic testing.

- Regression Coverage – Execute cross-platform regression testing prior to releases to ensure stability.

- Issue Investigation – Diagnose defects using logs, network tools, and API inspection techniques.

- Defect Lifecycle Management – Document, prioritize, and track defects while partnering with engineers on root-cause resolution.

- Environment Management – Maintain test environments, device coverage, and reliable platform test data.

- Risk Identification – Proactively surface quality risks during sprint planning and release cycles.

Here’s What You’ll Need To Be Successful:

- Cross-Platform Testing Experience – Demonstrated experience testing Mobile, Web, and/or backend systems.

- API Validation Expertise – Strong experience validating RESTful APIs and backend business logic.

- SDLC/STLC Knowledge – Solid understanding of software and testing lifecycle best practices.

- Testing Tool Proficiency – Hands-on experience with API testing tools such as Postman (or similar platforms).

- Technical Acumen – Ability to understand system architecture, integrations, and data flow.

- Startup Adaptability – Comfortable operating in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.

- Ownership Mindset – High level of accountability with strong independent execution.

- Clear Communication – Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Interview Process:

- Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.

- If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a video interview with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.

- If warranted, the next step would be a technical video interview with our QA Lead and QA Engineer for one (1) hour

- If warranted, the next step would be a final live technical assessment with our QA Lead and QA Engineer for one (1) hour

- If warranted, then we move to contract!

Compensation

Compensation is based on the role's scope, national market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals.

title: Senior User Acquisition Manager
description:
Ruby Labs is a leading technology company specialising in innovative consumer products across multiple technology sectors. The company focuses on D2C (Direct-to-Consumer) subscription products. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ 

About The Role

We are looking for Senior User Acquisition Manager (UAM) to take full ownership of TikTok acquisition for D2C products. This is a hands-on media buying role. You will be the owner of TikTok as an acquisition channel for your brand: from account structure, bidding and budget allocation to creative testing, measurement and scaling. You will work against real revenue data (CPA, ROAS, payback), not surface-level platform metrics, and you are expected to find and unlock new growth levers on your own.

We work AI-first, so we also expect you to use Claude and automation to speed up campaign builds, analysis, reporting and optimization.

Key Responsibilities

- Own all TikTok acquisition: strategy, execution, and results.

- Scale spend profitably across geos and funnels while holding CPA, ROAS and payback targets based on real revenue data.

- Build and optimize account structure, conversion events, bidding strategies and budget allocation (including Smart+ / automated campaign types, Spark Ads and other TikTok formats).

- Run a structured creative testing process: brief and iterate with the creative team, define hypotheses, decide what to kill and what to scale, and fight creative fatigue.

- Analyze performance daily and weekly, diagnose drops and spikes quickly, and act on them.

- Work with product, analytics and creative teams to improve funnels, signals and attribution quality.

- Maintain account health: handle ad disapprovals, appeals and restrictions, and build prevention-first habits so policy issues are caught before launch.

- Work with the TikTok team on betas, new campaign types, product changes and escalations.

- Document tests, learnings and playbooks so knowledge does not depend on one person.

- Use Claude and automation to speed up campaign builds, QA, reporting and optimization.

- Test new Paid Social Channels, such as: OpenAI Ads, X Ads, and others.

Qualifications

Must-Have Experience

- Senior: 5+ years of hands-on paid social / user acquisition experience.

- Strong hands-on TikTok Ads experience as a primary channel: scaling accounts profitably, not just running tests.

- Proven record of managing sizeable budgets independently: ideally $1M+/month on TikTok or paid social.

- Strong understanding of subscription / app economics: LTV, ROAS, payback windows, cohorts.

- Solid creative testing discipline and experience working with creative teams on concepts and iteration.

- Experience with policy issues: disapprovals, appeals, account restrictions.

- Analytical mindset: comfortable working with MMP / backend data and diagnosing performance from account-level data.

- Ownership mentality: able to run a channel end-to-end with minimal supervision.

- Clear, direct communication.

Strong Advantage

- Experience with D2C subscription, health, wellness or app products, and with web-to-app / web funnels.

- Experience with Meta or other paid social platforms alongside TikTok.

- Experience working directly with TikTok platform reps on betas and escalations.

- Experience building Claude, AI or automation workflows for media buying.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

- Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

- Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

- Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

- Company-provided MacBook: Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

- Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Read more about it here: Independent Contractor Agreement 

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

- Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

- Technical Interview (60 minutes)

- Final Interview (45 minutes)

- Integrate deeply with leading CCaaS platforms

- Maintain full conversation state and context

- Perform real-time actions within the CCaaS ecosystem

- Seamlessly hand off conversations to human agents — without losing context, history, or workflow state

- Support human agents with AI assistance after transfer

- AI + Real-Time Systems : Work on infrastructure that enables AI Agents to participate in live conversations at scale.

- Enterprise-Grade Integrations : Design robust integrations with major CCaaS platforms and customer systems.

- Human-AI Collaboration : Build the systems that make AI-to-human handoff seamless, contextual, and reliable.

- High-Impact Engineering : Your work directly determines how smoothly AI Agents operate in production environments.

- Design and build scalable backend services that integrate Cresta’s AI Agents with customers’ CCaaS platforms.

- Architect systems that manage real-time conversation state, context propagation, and session lifecycle.

- Implement seamless AI-to-human handoff mechanisms, ensuring full context transfer and minimal disruption to the customer experience.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories — the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed. 

Every part we make generates data, decisions, and handoffs. Your job is to capture that knowledge, automate the work around it, and remove whatever slows production down. When a critical defense program needs parts by next week, the systems you build are why we can deliver. 

The Role As a Full-Stack Software Engineer on our manufacturing intelligence team, you'll work wherever the leverage is highest. One week that means turning an operator's spreadsheet into a proper workflow; the next it means wiring machine data into scheduling, or cutting a manual quoting step out of the order flow. 

You'll own problems end to end across our customer portal, Enterprise Resource Planning / Manufacturing Execution System, and the data layer connecting them to the shop floor. 

Based at our HQ at “The Circle” (Zurich airport), your work will span: 

- Manufacturing Intelligence: Capturing process, machine, and quality data so knowledge lives in systems instead of in people's heads. 

- Automation: Replacing manual steps in quoting, planning, scheduling, and documentation with software that runs on its own. 

- Production Acceleration: Finding the bottlenecks between CAD/CAM data submission and shipped parts. 

- Tools for People: Building interfaces that make life easier for operators, engineers, and customers, whether that's a work instruction screen, a dashboard, or a self-service portal. 

Importantly, you do not need prior experience in the manufacturing domain. We value a high level of curiosity and autonomy to find and solve problems. 

What We're Looking For - Experience: 3+ years as a software engineer with proven experience in shipping code to production, across backend and frontend 

- Broad Technical Range: Experience in systems design, architecture and implementation. In general, you don’t shy away from new technologies and pick up whatever the problem requires. Our current tech stack is: Rust, PostgreSQL, React, Python, AWS. 

- End-to-End Ownership: From talking to the user, to schema, to API, to UI, to rollout. You don't hand off "the other half." 

- Industrial Grit: Comfortable spending time on the shop floor in Germany to understand how work actually happens and how your software interacts with precision machinery. 

- Autonomy: You are comfortable with diving into new topics, coming up with solutions and driving their implementation 

- Bonus points: Knowledge of manufacturing and how factories operate, basic understanding of the Manufacturing Automation Pyramid 

- On-site: Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland. 

What we're not looking for - Engineers who only work on frontend or only work on backend. You must be comfortable across the full stack. 

- People who need detailed specs before they start building. You'll work directly with users and define the solution yourself. 

- Developers who ship code and move on. You own the outcome — not just the PR. 

- E ngineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities. 

What we offer - Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of Europe . Your work directly enables the production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space 

- Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions, and have the authority to execute. 

- The Environment: You are building solutions to accelerate production in a 5,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial plastic and metal 3D printers. Your work affects production of physical parts from day one. 

- The Team: Growing team of experienced software engineers, who value an open feedback culture. You may (and are expected to) challenge the status quo, prior decisions and drive SAEKI’s way forward. 

- Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity. 

- Location: Zurich HQ with occasional travel to Factory ONE in Munich, Germany 

Apply - Resume: Focus on systems you've built and owned.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
Mattermost is the leading collaborative workflow platform for defense, intelligence, security, and critical infrastructure. Trusted by the U.S. Department of War and Fortune 500s, our platform runs on-premises and in private clouds, delivering secure messaging, file sharing, workflow automation, audio/screenshare, and project management—all with full data and operational control. Mattermost powers high-stakes workflows across mission planning, real-time, real-world operations, DevSecOps, incident response, and cyber defense—enabling secure collaboration from tactical edge and DDIL environments to enterprise HQ. Teams operate across web, desktop, and mobile, with embedded interoperability for Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365.

To learn more, visit www.mattermost.com 

We are seeking a Senior Mobile Engineer to take ownership of the Mattermost mobile experience for teams working in defense, intelligence, and critical infrastructure. Our users operate in DDIL environments where connectivity may be disconnected, denied, intermittent, or limited, security is non-negotiable, and the software they depend on has to keep working.

Our mobile app is primarily React Native and TypeScript today, with native iOS and Android integrations. Your immediate focus will be making that experience more reliable and performant. Over time, you'll also help shape the next generation of our cross-platform mobile architecture.

You'll work hands-on across application and native layers, partner closely with platform and feature teams, work directly with customer-facing teams on field reports from constrained environments, and help raise the bar for how we observe, diagnose, and build mobile software.

Responsibilities

Reliability and Performance 

- Architect the app for DDIL and other constrained network environments

- Improve data and functional reliability across connection lifecycle, synchronization, recovery, and failure scenarios

- Own crash-free and release-health outcomes, using telemetry to proactively identify regressions and drive them through diagnosis to resolution

- Profile and improve performance across startup, networking, storage, rendering, memory, and battery usage

Mobile Platform Ownership 

- Own critical iOS and Android integrations and the boundaries between native and cross-platform code

- Maintain and evolve platform capabilities including push notifications, background execution, secure storage, app lifecycle, and real-time communications

- Build within mobile distribution and device-management constraints, including App Store, enterprise and MDM deployment, AppConfig, and Intune MAM

- Diagnose production issues from native traces, telemetry, device profiling, and sparse field logs

- Make architecture recommendations that balance near-term delivery with the long-term direction of the mobile platform

Craft and Delivery 

- Mentor engineers on mobile architecture, reliability, performance, and platform best practices

- Uphold security and compliance standards required by government and enterprise customers

- Contribute to the open-source codebase

- Use AI coding tools effectively, applying strong engineering judgment to increase output without compromising reliability or quality

What We Are Looking For

We care about what you've built and the problems you've solved — not how long you've been building. If you have strong outcomes to speak to in mobile engineering, we want to hear from you.

Required: 

- Deep expertise in iOS or Android development, with strong working knowledge of the other platform

- Strong understanding of mobile architecture, platform SDKs, lifecycle constraints, and networking fundamentals

- Experience building reliable mobile systems that behave predictably through unreliable connectivity, local state changes, synchronization, and recovery

- Strong mobile performance profiling and production debugging skills on real devices

- Experience using production data, crash metrics, and release-health signals to drive reliability improvements

- Experience making architecture recommendations and owning technical outcomes

- Ability and willingness to work across native and cross-platform codebases

- AI fluency and experience using coding agents to increase engineering output while applying judgment to ensure reliable outcomes

Preferred: 

- Experience with React Native and TypeScript

- Experience with mobile persistence, synchronization, or offline-capable systems

- Experience with real-time communications or platform media frameworks such as WebRTC, CallKit, or Android audio APIs

- Experience with enterprise mobile distribution, MDM, AppConfig, or Intune MAM

- Experience building mobile software for security-sensitive, regulated, or operationally constrained environments

- Open-source contributions

Why Mattermost

- Mission-driven work: Your contributions directly support the organizations and missions that depend on secure, reliable collaboration including the U.S. Department of War and critical infrastructure operators worldwide

- Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere with a globally distributed, high-trust team built for autonomy and ownership

- AI-forward environment: We actively adopt and build AI-enabled workflows. Agentic development is core craft here, not a novelty

- End-to-end ownership: Ship and own complex software across the full stack with real accountability for what you build

- Open source at the core: Be part of a vibrant developer community shaping the future of secure collaboration

Compensation

Mattermost takes a market-based approach to pay. Actual compensation may vary based on location, skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions.

Target Salary Range: $165,000 – $215,000 

U.S. Eligibility & Compliance

This role may require obtaining and maintaining a U.S. government security clearance. Candidates must meet federal eligibility requirements to be considered.

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for access to export-controlled information as defined by U.S. export control laws, including EAR and ITAR. For more information visit the Bureau of Industry and Security and the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls .

Mattermost is an EEO Employer, we are a remote-first, open-source company.

We are continually working to expand our hiring in more countries and regions, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations, which takes time.

Mattermost values your unique perspective—we welcome all applicants. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and are committed to assessing candidates based on their skills and qualifications. We do not tolerate discrimination against staff or applicants based on race, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other personal characteristics.

If you require accommodations during the interview process, please let us know—we’re happy to assist.

You will have access to our Learning & Development Platform, regular feedback and opportunities to develop your expertise and career path. As Alma continues to grow across Europe, you will have the opportunity to work with colleagues from different teams, countries and areas of expertise.

We are committed to building a fair and inclusive workplace. We monitor our gender equality index and remain committed to pay equity, transparency and equal opportunities across the organisation.

- Influencing strategic decisions across the full Revenue organisation, from lead generation to churn.

- Combining analytical depth, business understanding and direct exposure to senior stakeholders.

- Helping Revenue teams build a stronger data culture and create more efficient ways of working as Alma scales across Europe.

🎯 Interview process

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description:
Join us in building the ultimate online playground! 

Poki is on a mission to create the ultimate online playground, bringing easy access to the best games on web to over 100 million monthly players worldwide. These games are created by a dynamic global community of 500+ game developer teams. At the core of our work lies a simple belief: play is how we learn. This value is embodied by our team of 70 unique individuals who each bring something special to the table.

What this job is about 

As a senior Frontend Developer at Poki, you'll shape how players experience our platform. All the way from the first vague problem to what happens after release. That might mean improving discovery on a slow connection, running an experiment, building a tool for our Content team, or fixing a part of the stack everyone has quietly learned to work around.

This is a senior role. That means we're looking for judgement, not just throughput.

Your Challenge as a senior Frontend Developer 

- Frontend that works on real devices. That means a three-year-old Android phone on unreliable wifi, not just the MacBook that will run anything you throw at it. If it only feels smooth on your machine, it is not done.

- Clear work from vague problems. You turn "players are leaving on slow connections" into a sensible scope, a first slice and a clear opinion about what can wait.

- Results you can point at. Decide what success looks like before you build, then use A/B tests and our data to see if you got there. If nothing moves, say so. Sometimes the right result is killing the thing you just built.

- Ownership in production. You build in enough monitoring to know when your work breaks, then stay with it until it is fixed. Shipping is the start of ownership, not the end.

- A stronger engineering team. Your reviews teach, your pairing unblocks people and the patterns you leave behind make the next piece of work easier.

- A stack and a codebase that survive contact with other people. You understand what still earns its place, what is hanging around through habit, and when changing it is worth the cost. What you leave behind, code and reasoning both, still makes sense six months later when the context is gone and somebody else needs to change it.

- Visible progress in small slices. Something useful in a week beats something theoretically perfect in two months. It also tells you much sooner when the idea was wrong.

You 

- Ownership of the whole scope, judgement before throughput. That includes the awkward parts that nobody volunteered for. The goal is not to produce more code, it is to build the right thing.

- Strong, production-level experience with React, Redux, TypeScript, HTML and CSS (7+ years). You've shipped and maintained SPAs at scale, not just built one from a tutorial, and you know where the codebase tends to rot if nobody's watching.

- Write tests with a reason . Use Playwright or something similar where it catches real problems, not because a coverage number looks better.

- Use AI to move faster while keeping the judgment, understanding and outcome yours. You do not ship something you cannot explain.

- Build something small and measure it. That turns gut feeling into evidence and shows which ideas deserve to become real features.

- Disagree properly, then commit . Make the case early and explain the tradeoffs in terms engineers and non-engineers can understand. Once the call is made you are in, including when it went the other way.

- Are familiar with Figma or a similar tool, and are comfortable translating designs into interactive web components.

Benefits 

We believe great work comes from feeling supported, trusted, and able to grow. Alongside meaningful professional development in the position mentioned above, we offer:

- A competitive salary, with annual performance reviews.

- Flexible working hours and a culture that genuinely supports a healthy work–life balance.

- €2,000 annual Learning & Development Budget for courses, training, and learning.

- Travel cost reimbursement for employees living outside of Amsterdam.

- 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus additional discretionary days.

- Hybrid work policy, with time split between home and our office, and the option to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.

- State-of-the-art equipment, plus a €2,000 work-from-home budget.

- Free breakfast, daily catered lunch, and fresh coffee and drinks in our pet-friendly office at Spui, in the heart of Amsterdam!

Unfortunately this isn't a remote position, we are looking for someone who will be able to work from our office in Amsterdam regularly.

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year ( Risk.net ). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 50+ of the world’s leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what’s technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role 

We’re looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to help run and grow the network and cloud estate behind our trading platform. Networking in our colocation data centres is the core of the role. The estate spans London, New York and Singapore, and from Q1 2027 a new Tokyo data centre.

This is a hands-on role in a small, expert infrastructure team. You’ll work closely with our Head of Infrastructure, following problems from the cross-connect through hosts, containers and AWS. You’ll also help keep infrastructure delivery on track, from timelines and reporting to working closely with our TechOps team.

What You’ll Work On 

- Low-latency networking across our colocation sites: switching and routing, cross-connects, BGP peering with liquidity providers and clients, and the fabric that carries our trading traffic

- Bringing new sites to application-ready, starting with Tokyo

- Our hybrid connectivity into multi-region AWS, including Direct Connect, routing and failover

title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenMusic
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two.

You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. Most of what you build is new, in a space where few companies are working with AI and music, so there’s no playbook. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days.

You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it.

Requirements 

- Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend

- Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex

- Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build

- Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them

- Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it

Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings.

Location 

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

- Human data platform: the labelling and evaluation platform research uses to continuously improve our models. You’ll ship new task editors, improve reliability, catch misuse and build the metrics behind higher-quality data pipelines.

- Core productions engine: the backend machine nobody sees but everybody relies on. You’ll build and maintain the services that run our production workflows, with room to lead projects.

- Editor platform: the professional editing tools our production teams work in. You’ll build in Rust, combining UI systems with a deep understanding of the underlying system.

We’re building professional tools and core infrastructure, not consumer features. The work is mostly building, with little hand-holding. You’ll carve out your own scope and own the outcome.

Requirements 

- Strong backend engineering experience, ideally in functional programming languages like Rust, with a full-stack focus on designing UI systems. You’ve shipped and run production systems end to end.

- Experience making systems reliable and scalable, such as internal platforms, workflow or task engines, or data pipelines. You take pride in the infrastructure nobody sees but everybody relies on.

- Comfortable switching between building a new tool or editor and hardening the platform underneath it, and keen to lead projects when the opportunity arises.

- Opinionated and able to defend your ideas, but know when to just grind. You’re happy doing the unglamorous work, and you’re hungry.

Bonus: 

- Experience building editor or UI-heavy professional tools, with a systems-level understanding of what sits underneath.

- Experience with data labelling or annotation platforms, or managing crowdsourced workforces.

Location 

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

title: Software Factory Engineer IV
description:
Start Date: Immediate

JHNA, CTSi, and EXPANSIA have come together to form a Defense Technology platform named Aether Aerospace focused on delivering high-impact technologies, technology-enabled services and advanced manufacturing solutions to the U.S. Department of Defense and related national security customers. Backed by Falfurrias Management Partners, the platform brings together deep domain expertise across Army, Navy, and Air Force and Space Force programs, digital engineering, systems integration, and specialized manufacturing capabilities.

The combined organization operates as a multi-entity aerospace and defense technology and tech-enabled services and manufacturing enterprise positioned for scalable growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation

OVERVIEW 

Full-time/Permanent Employee 

Location: Remote

As a Software Factory Engineer IV, you will design, integrate, and improve secure software factory capabilities used by multiple mission software teams. You will connect cloud infrastructure, DevSecOps pipelines, development tools, cybersecurity controls, observability, and reusable platform services into a coherent delivery environment. You will advise programs on how to onboard to and use existing Department of the Air Force software factories, such as Platform One, ODIN, and DAF CloudWorks, including the technical, security, governance, and operational steps that follow initial access. Working as an emerging technical authority with considerable latitude, you will guide complex integration decisions, improve common patterns and developer experience, and partner with government and contractor stakeholders to deliver reliable, accreditable software.

RESPONSIBILTIES

- Design and integrate software factory services spanning source control, CI/CD, artifact repositories, registries, security scanning, test automation, secrets, cloud infrastructure, and observability

- Advise programs on factory selection and onboarding, including application architecture, access and identity, environment needs, interfaces, inherited and application-specific controls, release paths, and sustainment responsibilities

- Lead technical integration of applications with established factories, including Platform One, ODIN, or DAF CloudWorks as applicable; resolve gaps between factory services and program delivery needs

- Establish reusable CI/CD templates, infrastructure-as-code modules, container baselines, deployment patterns, and platform services that scale across application teams

- Architect secure cloud and container environments, including networking, identity, secrets, storage, compute, Kubernetes, logging, and separation of environments

- Embed automated testing, SAST/DAST/SCA, SBOMs, artifact provenance, vulnerability management, and evidence collection into delivery workflows in partnership with RMF/ATO stakeholders

- Define application onboarding and self-service practices, documentation, templates, APIs, and support pathways that improve developer experience and reduce time to first deployment

- Guide artifact promotion, configuration management, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and reliability practices across development, test, and production

- Troubleshoot complex platform and toolchain issues, assess design tradeoffs, and implement changes that improve security, availability, performance, and maintainability

- Mentor engineers and application teams, share architectural patterns and lessons learned, and coordinate technical decisions with customer and cybersecurity stakeholders

- Measure platform adoption, onboarding friction, delivery performance, and operational health; use the results to prioritize improvements

- Provide technical support to operational strategies aligned within your program and initiatives that optimize processes, enhance productivity, and ensure quality across all program functions

- Ensure 100% of planned hours are worked and recorded

- Identify and forward to your leadership any opportunities that could lead to growth within your work area

- Participate in growth efforts as requested

- Ensure all contractual deliverables are met/exceeded to the customer's satisfaction

- Complete personal PDP and attend Staff Meeting and Storytime (with camera on)

- Within your program, build productive and positive professional relationships with clients

- Execute all contract requirements as assigned in accordance with the contract-specific LCAT and requirements

- Perform other related duties as assigned

KEY QUALIFICATIONS

Clearance: Active TS/SCI
Education and Years of Experience: Bachelor's (or equivalent) with 8 - 10 years of experience, or a Master's with 6 - 8 years of experience in software factory engineering, DevSecOps, cloud/platform engineering, or IT operations

- Extensive experience designing and integrating shared software delivery platforms, DevSecOps toolchains, and reusable CI/CD patterns across teams

- Demonstrated experience guiding application teams through onboarding and sustained use of an established software factory, including security, access, integration, and release considerations

- Proficiency in infrastructure as code such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation and advanced scripting with Python, Bash, or PowerShell

- Strong cloud architecture expertise in AWS or Azure, including identity, networking, storage, compute, containers, and Kubernetes

- Hands-on knowledge of automated security controls, software supply-chain protections, observability, and RMF/ATO evidence needs in DoD delivery

PREFERRED ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS 

- Experience with Platform One, ODIN, DAF CloudWorks, or a comparable DoD software factory from both the platform and program application perspectives

- Experience establishing standardized onboarding, self-service platform capabilities, and reusable development patterns for multiple programs

- Knowledge of hardened container baselines, SBOMs, artifact provenance, security scanning, and continuous assessment practices

- Experience with high-availability cloud architecture, networking, monitoring, and incident response

- Experience mentoring engineers and evaluating AI-assisted or agentic development workflows, including MCP integrations, in a controlled delivery environment

Aether Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Product Design Lead
description:
Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â 

We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â 

This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â 

You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â 

If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â 

What you'll do: - Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â 
- Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â 
- Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â 
- Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â 
- Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â 
- Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
- Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
- Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
- Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 

What you'll bring: - Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â 
- Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â 
- Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â 
- The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
- The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
- Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â 
- Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â 
- Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â 
- Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â 
- Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â

title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
description:
Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one. 

Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex , real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech? 

The Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program at Picnic is a two-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.

At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket. 
We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.

Tricks of the trade 

- Lead with ambition : Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.

- Steep learning curve : Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.

- Solve real-life puzzles : Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.

- Innovate across borders : You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.

- High-performance environment : You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.

From learning to leading 

Throughout the two-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.

You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.

As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, the pace is yours to set, and there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to learn, and lead.

Where you’ll make an impact 

From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:

- Consumer - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic.

- Tech - Work at the intersection of product and infrastructure, building scalable systems that power our operations. Think: building software and algorithms our FCAs run on or launch new features in our app used by millions. 

- Logistics - Build the backbone of Picnic: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more

Your superpowers 

You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.

More specifically, you:

- Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a quantitative field : e.g., mathematics, econometrics, engineering, or similar

- Have experience in high-performance environments: consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships and know what it means to raise the bar.

- Show an entrepreneurial mindset : you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked

- Think like a builder : hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions

- You have already gained basic knowledge in PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel or alternative coding languages 

Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective. 

Why Picnic? 

- Grow as we grow . We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. Grow your impact as we grow; we invest in your path but the driver's seat is always yours.

- Work with other innovators. Work with a driven, energetic team that builds, wins, and celebrates together (think of legendary Friday drinks, our Ski trip and our parties)

- Kickstart your career. Earn a competitive salary and step into a program designed to launch your long-term future at Picnic.

When are you joining? 

- Fall Edition 2026
Start dates: September, October
*earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question 

- Spring Edition 2027
Start dates: February, March
*earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question 

📍 Location: Full-time in Amsterdam, with periodic trips to DE or FR

There is no deadline : Our aim is to find the most ambitious people out there. We onboard talents on a monthly basis, so whether you join in April or August, you’ll always have a group of people sharing the ride. 

Picnic Perks 

🥗 Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks
Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen and chefs. They prepare delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

🚲 Health insurance discount & bike plan
We have a partnership with CZ (a health insurance provider). Picnic employees get a discount on CZ insurance packages between 5% and 15%. Furthermore, through our partnership with Lease a Bike, you can rent-to-own a new (e)bike at a discounted rate

🗺️ Relocation
If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs for you and your partner and kids, your first month's rent and moving costs (up to €2000), and help you with the 30% tax ruling setup and application. 

🍎 Learning & development 
You’ll get ample opportunity to work on yourself at Picnic. We offer personal development through Lepaya courses, Academy trainings, and more. Interested in improving your mental wellbeing? Through OpenUp you get free access to trained psychologists and many courses. 

⛳ All the rest 
At Picnic you get 25 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, as well.

FAQ 

Do I need a quantitative background? It's a strong advantage, but not a hard requirement. If your internships and projects demonstrate real hands-on ownership and data-driven thinking, we'll consider your application. You do need a Master's degree, basic knowledge of Python or SQL, and relevant work experience.

Does the program include rotations? No, intentionally. We believe depth creates ownership, and ownership creates impact. Rather than rotating across teams, you’ll go deep in one area, build real expertise, and gradually expand your scope as your impact grows. If you have topic preferences, tell us during the process.

In what language should I apply? English. Please include your CV and Master's degree transcript or any other relevant test scores (e.g., GMAT)

What are the long-term opportunities after the program? This program is a fast track into a high-impact career at Picnic, it’s an entry point for a long-term future, not a two-year stopover. 

Career paths here are as varied as the people on them. Some grow vertically, building deep expertise and a team around them as their project expands. Others move laterally - from Commercial to Fulfilment, Distribution to Customer, or wherever their strengths and ambitions take them. What they share is real ownership, real impact, and a career they shaped themselves.

title: Staff Quality Assurance Engineer

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Travel: 
Job ID: 1917 

The Role: 

We are looking for a Staff QA Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will own product-level quality assurance: the system test plans, automation and compliance test execution that stand between an engineering release and a product customers can trust. In a security product, QA is not an afterthought; it is part of the evidence.

Responsibilities :

You will define and execute system-level test plans for FPGA-based cryptographic products: functional, performance, stress, stability and negative testing across the full stack, from hardware through firmware and drivers to cryptographic APIs. You will build and maintain the automated QA infrastructure (regression suites, hardware-in-the-loop test benches, CI integration, results dashboards), execute standards-based compliance test campaigns (NIST ACVP/CAVP test vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence runs, CNSA 2.0 checklists and standard FPGA compliance tests) together with our verification and security engineers, run interoperability testing against protocol stacks and customer-representative configurations, own defect tracking and triage, and define the release-qualification criteria for every product release.

- Own system-level QA of cryptographic hardware products: test plans, automation, execution and release qualification

- Execute standards and compliance test campaigns (ACVP/CAVP vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence, CNSA 2.0 and FPGA compliance tests) as part of the certification effort

Requirements: 

We are looking for a candidate with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience) and at least five years in quality assurance or system test of embedded, hardware or networking products. You have built test automation in Python or similar, integrated it into CI, and worked hands-on with lab equipment and hardware-in-the-loop setups.

Exposure to security or compliance testing (FIPS, Common Criteria, or telecom/industrial certification regimes) is a strong plus, as is experience testing cryptographic or networking functionality. You are rigorous, methodical and precise in documentation, because in this product your test reports become certification evidence. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

- Experienced system-test/QA engineer for embedded or hardware products with strong automation skills

- Compliance or security test experience and meticulous documentation habits are strong advantages

Preferred Qualifications: 

You take professional pride in being the last line of defence before a release, you like breaking things methodically so customers never do, and you enjoy the extra weight QA carries when the product is a security device.
