Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. 

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. title: Team Lead Software Engineer
description:
We’re Capital on Tap 
Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier. 

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started! 

We opened our first Portuguese office in Porto in autumn 2025, and in less than a year it has grown to a team of 50. Lisbon is the next step. We're opening our first office in the city and looking for engineers to join as founding members of the team, helping shape how we build, hire and work here from day one.

The role starts out fully remote. Once our Lisbon office is open, it will move to a hybrid set-up of two days a week on site.

Salary: €70,000 - 90,000

What You’ll Be Doing 

We're looking for an Engineering Team Lead to lead one of our product engineering teams here at Capital on Tap.

This is a people-first leadership role. You'll be responsible for the growth, wellbeing, and performance of a team of engineers, while staying technically credible enough to shape direction, remove blockers, and raise the bar on quality. You won't be the best coder in the room you'll be the person who makes the whole room better.

If you're an experienced Team Lead Engineer looking to own a team in a scaling fintech, this role is built for you.

What You'll Own

Your team. Hiring, developing, and retaining engineers. Running 1:1s that actually matter. Spotting who's ready to grow and creating the space for them to do it.

Delivery. Partnering with Product and QA to plan and ship reliably not by micromanaging, but by removing obstacles, managing risk, and keeping the team focused on what matters.

Culture. Setting the tone for how the team communicates, gives feedback, and holds itself accountable. Building psychological safety without sacrificing standards.

Technical credibility. You won't be heads-down in the codebase every day, but you'll understand the trade-offs your team is navigating architecture decisions, technical debt, build vs buy and contribute meaningfully to those conversations.

What We're Looking For

Leadership first. You've managed engineers before and have a point of view on what good looks like. You know how to have hard conversations, give developmental feedback, and motivate people.

Technical foundation in .NET. Our backend is C#/.NET Core and you'll need enough depth to earn trust with your engineers, review decisions, and spot risks. You don't need to be across every layer of the stack you need to be honest about what you know and curious about what you don't.

Product mindset. You think about engineering in the context of business outcomes, not just technical correctness. You can push back on scope, advocate for quality, and translate between engineering and non-technical stakeholders.

Comfort with ambiguity. Capital on Tap is growing. Priorities shift. We want someone who creates clarity for their team rather than waiting for it.

Nice to Have

- Experience with Azure cloud development

- Familiarity with React or other frontend frameworks

- Background in financial services or fintech

Diversity & Inclusion 
We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

Interview Process 

- First stage: 30 minute intro call with Talent Partner

- Second stage: 60 minute "Tech Chat" & Values Interview with an Engineering Manager & People Partner

- Third stage: 60 minute Code Pairing with our Engineering Team

- Final stage: 60 minute Case Study with Product & Engineering + 60 minute Good to Great Interview with our CTO

Great Work Deserves Great Perks 

Check out our benefits:

Private Healthcare through AdvanceCare
Anniversary Rewards (€280, €570, €860, 4-week fully paid sabbatical)

️ 36 days holiday (inclusive of public holidays with public holidays carried over if they fall on a weekend)
Annual Learning and Wellbeing Budget
6 free therapy sessions per year
Free drinks and snacks in our offices

Other Info
Check out our ‘Top Tips’ for interviewing. 
✔️Keep updated on new job opportunities by following us on Linkedin .
Email careers@capitalontap.com if you have any questions.

title: Senior AI Consultant

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including prioritizing, problem solving and relationship building.

title: Solutions Architect (EST or PST hours)
description:
Company Overview 

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm 

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Note: This individual must be based in either Eastern or Pacific Time in the US. or willing to work during these time zone work hours

Opportunity
Deepgram is seeking a talented, support-focused Solutions Architect (Applied Engineer) to join our Applied Engineering (AppEng) team. In this role, you will directly engage with customers to solve complex technical challenges while simultaneously building scalable solutions that enhance our support infrastructure. You'll own complete customer engagements in a post-sales capacity, and occasionally assist with pre-sales and implementation projects as needed. Your strong engineering background will enable you to resolve sophisticated technical issues, create repeatable solutions, and develop automation that allows the broader AppEng team to focus on high-impact pre-sales activities. This position offers an excellent path to grow into broader implementation and pre-sales roles while making an immediate impact on our customer support experience. As a key member of the Applied Engineering team, you'll influence our customer support strategy, and play a crucial role in ensuring our customers receive exceptional technical assistance throughout their journey with Deepgram.

About Applied Engineering at Deepgram
The Applied Engineering (AppEng) team at Deepgram combines the functions that other companies might separate into Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Implementation, and Technical Support. We serve as the technical interface between Deepgram and our customers throughout their entire journey, from initial discovery and proof-of-concept, through implementation and onboarding, to ongoing technical support. We work closely with our Customer Success and Developer Experience (DX) teams to ensure a positive, growth-focused experience for our customers. This unified approach allows us to provide comprehensive technical guidance and build deeper relationships with our customers. As a support-focused Applied Engineer, you'll be primarily concerned with elevating our technical support capabilities while having opportunities to contribute to the broader Applied Engineering mission in pre-sales, implementation, and more.

What you'll do 

- 
Own the technical design and delivery of customer implementations and migrations, from kickoff through production cutover

- 
Lead deployment scaling work, including capacity planning, rollout sequencing, and verification methodology

- 
Design solutions that fit each customer's existing stack, constraints, and operational shape

- 
Partner with Customer Success and Account Executives on customer-side change management, including readiness, stakeholder alignment, and rollout communication

- 
Develop reusable implementation patterns, reference architectures, and deployment playbooks that the broader AppEng team and customers can reuse

- 
Create automation and self-service tooling that compresses time-to-value for repeatable implementation work

- 
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and influence the roadmap based on patterns observed in active deployments

- 
Provide support for the most complex post-onboarding cases when escalation crosses into Solutions Architect territory

- 
Occasionally support pre-sales technical work, including discovery, scoping, and proof-of-concept design

Time allocation 

- 
50% — Customer implementation and scaling engagements

- 
20% — Building reusable patterns, reference architectures, and automation

- 
15% — Pre-sales technical support, including discovery, demos, and proof-of-concepts

- 
10% — Documentation and knowledge sharing

- 
5% — Complex post-onboarding escalations and collaboration with Technical Support Engineers

Your first 90 days 

- 
First 30 days — Complete comprehensive onboarding to understand Deepgram's technology, products, and the patterns we use for implementations. Gain proficiency with our core APIs and documentation. Shadow active implementation engagements to build familiarity with how the AppEng team operates during customer change phases.

- 
60 days — Begin owning customer implementation engagements end-to-end, leading technical design and partnering with Customer Success on rollout. Start contributing to reusable implementation patterns and reference architectures.

- 
90 days — Own the technical delivery of multiple concurrent customer implementations. Develop and deliver scalable solutions for repeatable customer change patterns. Begin contributing to the Applied Engineering team's implementation methodology and mentoring newer team members.

You'll love this role if you... 

- 
Enjoy seeing customer technical environments transformed through careful implementation work

- 
Are passionate about reducing the time it takes any customer to reach production value with Deepgram

- 
Find satisfaction in designing patterns that scale beyond a single customer engagement

- 
Have a talent for identifying recurring needs across customers and translating them into reusable artifacts

- 
Are energized by deploying cutting-edge Voice AI in production environments with real customers

- 
See implementation work as a strategic function that drives customer growth and retention

It's important to us that you have 

- 
3+ years of experience implementing or deploying technical solutions for enterprise customers, ideally in customer-facing technical roles

- 
Strong software engineering background with professional development experience in at least one modern programming language, such as Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, Rust, C / C++, or similar languages

- 
Experience leading technical delivery of production deployments, from design through cutover

- 
Proven ability to scope complex technical work and sequence it for successful delivery

- 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering and business stakeholders alike

It would be great if you had 

- 
Experience with speech recognition, natural language processing, AI Voice agents, or related AI technologies

- 
Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes

- 
Experience with API-first products and developer tools

- 
Background in change-management or implementation methodology

- 
Experience producing reference architectures, deployment playbooks, or implementation templates

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - German Speaking
description:
About HappyRobot 

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. 

Role Overview 

We are looking for a versatile and highly skilled German-speaking Forward Deployed Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will combine strong technical abilities with excellent communication skills, working directly with customers to ensure they maximize the value of HappyRobot’s AI platform. You will be involved in onboarding, implementation, and ongoing support, while also contributing to product development and innovation.

At HappyRobot, there’s no role seniority or hierarchy — we operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You’ll Do

- Customer-Facing Engineering – Work closely with customers from onboarding to ongoing usage, helping them integrate and optimize our AI solutions.

- Technical Development – Build new features, MVPs, and scalable solutions that directly impact customer outcomes.

- Full-Stack Development – Utilize React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python to develop robust applications and tools.

- AI/ML Applications – Design, implement, and iterate on AI/ML solutions, including LLM prompting, tuning of voices, and transcribers to optimize use cases.

- Integration & APIs – Manage APIs and integrations with third-party systems to ensure seamless functionality for customers.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration – Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to deliver tailored solutions.

- Iterative Problem-Solving – Continuously iterate and improve AI solutions based on customer feedback and evolving requirements.

- Project Management – Prioritize and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines while maintaining high-quality results.

Must Have

- Strong full-stack experience: React, TypeScript, Node.js.

- Hands-on proficiency in Python.

- Experience building AI/ML applications, including LLM prompting and tuning.

- Ability to manage APIs and integrate with third-party systems.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

- Proven ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.

- Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Why join us? 

- Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

- Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

- Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

- Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

- Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles 

Extreme Ownership 

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship 

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

title: Senior Applied Research Engineer - Video
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

As an Applied Research Engineer in our Video team, you will help build the next generation of production-grade foundation models for human-centric video generation.

You will join a highly focused team working at the intersection of large-scale generative modeling, distributed systems, and production engineering. Our mission is to develop and optimize video base models that power realistic, controllable, and emotionally expressive synthetic humans at scale.

This is not pure research. This is applied research with direct product impact.

You will work on advancing training recipes, scaling distributed systems, improving evaluation frameworks, and optimizing inference to ensure our models are high quality, stable, and efficient enough for real-world deployment. Your work will directly influence models used by tens of thousands of businesses worldwide.

What you’ll do 

You will own and execute end-to-end research and engineering projects, from hypothesis to production impact. This includes:

- Developing and scaling latent video diffusion models tailored for human-centric video generation

- Designing conditioning mechanisms to improve control (pose, emotion, script, camera) without sacrificing fidelity

- Advancing distributed training strategies (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, sequence parallelism) under real compute constraints

- Improving training stability at multi-node scale

- Designing rigorous evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics and structured human evaluation

- Optimizing inference for low latency, high resolution, and cost efficiency 

- Running controlled ablations and experiments to drive high-signal modeling decisions

- Contributing to high engineering standards: reproducibility, experiment tracking, CI/CD, monitoring

You will be expected to move fast, run multiple hypotheses in parallel, identify signal early, and focus on outcomes rather than exploration for its own sake.

What we’re looking for 

Must-have

- Strong experience training deep learning models at scale

- Strong Python and PyTorch skills

- Hands-on experience with diffusion models (image domain required; video preferred)

- Experience with large scale multi-GPU / multi-node training

- Good understanding of distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed or similar)

- Ability to design controlled experiments and interpret noisy results

Nice-to-have

- Experience with video diffusion models

- Experience in avatar or human-centric generation

- Familiarity with world / interactive models

- Experience with GANs or VAEs

Experience optimizing inference systems for production

Our stack

- Python, PyTorch, CUDA

- DeepSpeed, distributed training & inference

- Sequence parallelism

- AWS, SLURM, Docker

- GitHub, CI/CD pipelines

Who you are

- You are research-driven but outcome-focused

- You care about shipping, not just publishing

- You can explore multiple ideas quickly and drop low-signal directions early

- You communicate clearly and present results scientifically

- You operate independently but collaborate actively across teams

Why join us?

- Build production-scale video foundation models in a fast-growing Generative AI company

- Work on human-centric video generation with real-world impact

- Tackle hard problems in scaling, stability, and controllability

- Influence the direction of next-generation synthetic human technology

- Join a highly technical, high-ownership environment where your work ships

If you want to work on cutting-edge generative video models and see your research power real-world products, we’d love to talk.

Our culture 

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here. 

Serving 50,000+ customers (and 50% of the Fortune 500) 

We’re trusted by leading brands such as Heineken, Zoom, Xerox, McDonald’s and more. Read stories from happy customers and what 1,200+ people say on G2 .

Proprietary AI technology 

Since 2017, we’ve been pioneering advancements in Generative AI. Our AI technology is built in-house, by a team of world-class AI researchers and engineers. Learn more about our AI Research Lab and the team behind. 

AI Safety, Ethics and Security 

AI safety, ethics, and security are fundamental to our mission. While the full scope of Artificial Intelligence's impact on our society is still unfolding, our position is clear: People first. Always. Learn more about our commitments to AI Ethics, Safety & Security .

title: Software Development Engineer in Test | Luma
description:
Our Why At Dotmatics 

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research. 

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics 

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. 

What do we need 

We are seeking an SDET to join one of our agile engineering teams and help us build quality into LUMA, our scientific software platform. You'll take ownership of testing for a specific module of the application — writing and maintaining automated tests, exploring new features, and working alongside developers, application scientists and DevOps engineers to make sure what we ship is reliable.

This is a hands-on automation role with room to grow. You'll be contributing to established test frameworks rather than building them from scratch, with support from senior SDETs who will help you develop your technical depth and your understanding of the science behind the product.

While the primary focus is automation, the role also involves manual exploratory testing.

In this role you will get to: 

- Write, maintain and extend automated test suites for your module using Cucumber, TypeScript and Cypress (and Playwright where we use it).

- Own day-to-day quality for your area: contributing test scenarios during planning, testing stories as they're built, and giving the team a clear picture of release readiness.

- Design and document test cases that cover functional, regression and integration scenarios, and keep them useful as the product evolves.

- Investigate and reproduce defects, raise well-evidenced bug reports in JIRA, and verify fixes with developers and scientists.

- Keep your tests green and trustworthy in our CI pipelines, and help improve how tests run and report.

- Learn to read and interpret API documentation and turn it into meaningful automated coverage.

- Work with leading experts in software development, scientific product management and test automation — and be mentored by them.

Who we're looking for: 

You'll have 2–5 years' experience in QA/testing, including at least a year of hands-on test automation . You're comfortable working in a code-first way, you enjoy digging into how things work, and you're happy asking questions when a domain is unfamiliar. You work carefully and pay attention to detail, and you can take a story or module, understand it and devise a concrete approach to testing going above and beyond the standard acceptance criteria.

Just as importantly, you want to get better. We're looking for someone who takes feedback well, is curious about the scientific problems our users are solving and wants to grow into a senior automation engineer over time.

The Key Skills we are looking for: 

- Practical experience with Cypress — writing tests, using selectors and custom commands, debugging failures, and working within an existing Page Object Model. Experience testing React applications is a plus.

- Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript , including asynchronous code (promises, async/await). You don't need to be an expert in generics and interfaces, but you should be able to read and write clean, maintainable test code.

- Experience with BDD / Cucumber , or a willingness to pick it up quickly — we write most of our specs in Gherkin.

- Test case design and documentation — the ability to break a feature down into clear, repeatable scenarios and write them up so others can follow them.

- Comfort with Git and GitHub , including branching, pull requests and code review, plus experience working in JIRA or a similar tracking system.

You may also have: 

- Experience with Playwright, or interest in learning it — we use it for a subset of our tests.

- Exposure to API testing tools (Postman, REST clients) or writing API-level automated tests.

- Any experience with performance or load testing (K6 or similar).

- Familiarity with validating data integrity across release upgrades, migrations or schema changes.

- A background or interest in science, engineering or research software.

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Data
description:
About Dune 

Dune is on a mission to make crypto data accessible. We’re a collaborative multi-chain analytics platform used by thousands of developers, analysts, & investors to understand the on-chain world and the frontiers of finance. We’re a team of ~60 employees, working together across Europe and eastern US timezones ️. We believe in our mission, and in building a powerful, open product that allows individuals and communities to do deep research into important ecosystems like Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and many more. 

We’re backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that allowed us to double down on our mission. We’re using the funds to educate, reward and empower a new generation of onchain analysts aka Wizards ‍♀️

If you want to have one of the highest impact jobs on the planet, come join our wonderful team of Galaxy brains.

Learn more about us: 

Dune's Vision 

Values and working at Dune 

About the role 

Data Foundation owns how blockchain data enters Dune, how it is represented and how it’s delivered externally. This is a role that involves thinking about large distributed data systems, recognising traditional scaling patterns and software lifecycle pitfalls, and is ideal for anyone passionate about those topics.

You will be the engineer we hand ambiguous product requirements to, and will be comfortable coming back with a design, a sequence, and a set of tasks the team can pick up as well as building the hardest parts yourself.

In this role you will 

- 
Turn product requirements into technical requirements: model the domain, define the interfaces and the workflows, and navigate trade-offs

- 
Break large problems into work other engineers can own, and sequence it so we ship something useful early

- 
Drive high-impact architectural decisions across the data platform, and own components end to end from design through production

- 
Work across our stack, mainly Go, Kotlin, Rust and Python where they fit, choosing the right tool rather than the familiar one

- 
Design for correctness and performance under real volume: large-scale ingestion, distributed processing, and data lake storage

- 
Raise the bar on design reviews, testing, and how the team breaks work down

- 
Mentor engineers by example, in a fully distributed team

You might be a great fit if 

- 
You are a strong generalist with real computer science fundamentals, and you use them to adapt quickly to new technologies and problem spaces

- 
You reason from first principles: you make assumptions explicit, identify the constraints and invariants that matter, and derive the solution rather than reaching for a familiar pattern.

- 
You use computer science fundamentals as practical tools. You have designed and shipped distributed data systems, making their contracts, state transitions, invariants, and failure modes explicit. You know their fault models and scaling weaknesses

- 
You are comfortable with ambiguity : you will talk to product, to customers, and to the team, then commit to a scope and defend it

- 
You use AI tools well enough that they have changed how you work, you understand their failure modes and dislike ai-slop.

- 
You communicate clearly in writing and get the best out of a distributed team

Not required, but a plus 

- 
Experience with data lakes and formats such as Parquet, Iceberg or Deltalog

- 
Experience at a company where the data is the product

Perks & Benefits 

- 
A competitive salary and equity package . Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

- 
Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window

- 
5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you) 

- 
A fully remote-first approach ‍ within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day 

- 
Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

- 
Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard 

- 
We believe in paid parental leave to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule

- 
Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany Berlin Austria and Athens ).

- 
On top of this each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.

- 
An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.

- 
Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!

- 
And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag ! ✌️

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Full time paid Internship DSU/ Stage DSU Paris
description:
Introduction The selected person will join the Technopolis Group Data Science Unit (DSU), whose members work across different country offices. Our growing team brings together diverse academic backgrounds and a shared passion for developing data science applications to improve policymaking.
The DSU contributes to policy consulting projects and conducts R&D to develop and test new applications, sometimes in collaboration with internal and external partners. Its work includes record linkage, classification, natural language processing, web scraping, generative AI and dynamic visualisations.
As an intern, you will work alongside experienced data scientists and policy consultants, applying and developing your technical skills to address real-world policy questions.

About this job The role of the intern in data science for public policy will be to support the data science components of policy evaluations , sectoral studies and strategic consultancy projects. Our clients include French regional councils, the French Development Agency (AFD), ADEME, the European Commission and multilateral development banks.
You will be part of the DSU and collaborate with colleagues across policy areas, including science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition, international cooperation and health. You may also contribute to internal R&D and business development activities, particularly the preparation of data science approaches for project proposals.
No previous professional experience is required. Relevant coursework, academic research and personal coding projects will be considered.
We are looking to recruit a full-time intern for at least 6 months starting in Automn 2026 . Internship should be sponsored by the intern’s university (stage conventionné).

Your profile We are looking for a curious and motivated individual who enjoys working with data and wants to understand how data science can inform public policy.
Suitable candidates should have:
- Master’s-level studies in data science, computer science, statistics, economics, engineering or another relevant discipline with a strong quantitative component, and be eligible for a university-sponsored internship.
- Practical programming skills in Python, demonstrated through coursework, research or personal projects, and the ability to write and understand their own analytical code.
- Good foundations in statistics and quantitative analysis, together with an interest in economics and public policy and in interpreting analytical results in their policy context.
- Basic familiarity with machine learning or natural language processing, and an interest in using generative AI and large language models programmatically through APIs for data processing, text analysis and knowledge extraction.
- A careful and structured approach to working with data, including attention to data quality, validation, documentation and reproducibility.
- An interest in public policy and in using data science to support evidence-based policymaking , particularly in areas such as science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition or health policy.
- Fluency in French and English, good communication skills and an ability to work collaboratively in an international and multicultural environment. A third language would be an asset.

Your responsibilities Working under the guidance of experienced colleagues, you will:
- Support the design and implementation of data science analyses to answer policy questions, writing code in Python.
- Collect, clean, link and validate data from multiple sources, including open datasets, databases and web-based sources.
- Help develop and test analytical workflows, potentially involving machine learning, NLP and LLM APIs for classification, text analysis and knowledge extraction.
- Contribute to indicators, scoreboards and visualisations, including dashboards where relevant, to make findings accessible to different audiences.
- Interpret and communicate results, helping prepare reports, methodological documentation and presentations for clients.
- Contribute to the DSU’s R&D and proposal preparation, for example by exploring new datasets, testing methods or developing small prototypes.

Our offer We offer a paid internship in Paris, with hands-on experience at the intersection of data science and public policy. You will work with an international, multidisciplinary team, receive guidance from experienced colleagues and contribute to both client projects and the development of new analytical applications.
Many of our interns become full-time staff at Technopolis or go on to pursue opportunities in the public and private sectors.

More about Polar and how we work 

What you could work on

Depending on your experience and where you can have the greatest impact, this could include:

- 
Own product development end-to-end: Identifying opportunities, shipping and iterating on features across our stack – taking responsibility for both the technical implementation and the product outcome.

Build exceptional developer experiences: Bringing a strong eye for design, usability and detail to everything you ship. Turning complex billing and monetization workflows into intuitive interfaces, powerful APIs and thoughtful abstractions that make our merchants’ lives easier.

- 
Ship with speed and quality: Delivering improvements continuously, balancing fast iterations with robust engineering, performance and attention to detail.

- 
Stay close to our users: Engaging with our merchants, to understand how they use Polar, uncover pain points and translate feedback into meaningful product improvements.

What we look for

We’re particularly interested in senior engineers who combine strong technical foundations with exceptional product judgement and design sensibility. People who care deeply about developer experience, have opinions about what makes great software and know that building the right thing often means knowing what not to build.

Some of the qualities and experience we value in this area include:

- 
Strong technical foundations: Experience building, shipping and evolving production software, with deep expertise in at least one part of the stack and the ability to work confidently across frontend and backend systems. You’ve built and maintained products long enough to understand how early technical and product decisions hold up as they evolve and scale.

- 
Product judgement & design sensibility: A deep appreciation for how products look, feel and work. An understanding that developer experience is the product, from the clarity of an API to the smallest details of an interface. Strong opinions, loosely held, and the judgement to challenge assumptions, simplify complexity and know what to leave out.

- 
Ownership & pragmatic execution: The ability to take problems end-to-end with high ownership and autonomy, navigate ambiguity, make decisions without perfect information and take responsibility for outcomes. A bias towards shipping and knowing when to iterate quickly and when to invest in stronger foundations.

- 
Engineering craft: A commitment to the quality of what gets built – from clean APIs and robust backend logic to thoughtful interactions, edge-case handling and performance. High standards for both technical quality and the experience delivered.

- 
Curiosity & collaboration: A willingness to wear multiple hats, collaborate openly and contribute to a small team. Curiosity to learn new technologies and use tools, including AI-assisted development, while maintaining intimacy with the code, sound engineering judgement and ownership of what gets shipped.

Experience with payments, billing or developer tools is a strong plus.

We also love seeing open-source contributions and side projects.

Our stack

Frontend: Typescript (React, Effect)

- 
Backend: Python (FastAPI, Dramatiq)

- 
Infrastructure: Postgres, Clickhouse, AWS.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Agentic Search) – Web Rendering Engineer
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product 

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible. We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the rendering infrastructure behind a novel search engine designed for agentic AI. In this role, you will design systems that transform modern web applications into high quality structured content for search and AI. You will work on browser rendering, JavaScript execution, and large-scale rendering infrastructure capable of processing billions of pages efficiently. Modern websites increasingly rely on client-side rendering, dynamic data loading, and complex application frameworks. Your work will ensure we can reliably render, understand, and extract valuable information while minimising cost and latency. 

In this position, your responsibility will be to: 

- Design and build large-scale rendering systems for modern web applications

- Develop browser-based rendering infrastructure capable of executing complex JavaScript applications reliably

- Research how modern frontend frameworks render and deliver content

- Improve rendering quality, completeness, and performance across diverse websites

- Optimise rendering cost, latency, resource utilisation, and throughput at internet scale

- Translate rendering research into reliable production systems

You may be a good fit if you: 

Have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer working on production backend or infrastructure systems and are an expert in several of the following areas:

- Browser Rendering

- Chromium rendering pipeline — DOM, Layout, Paint, and Compositing

- JavaScript execution inside browsers and rendering lifecycle and page readiness

- Headless browser execution and browser instrumentation

- Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP)

- Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or similar frameworks Modern Web Applications

- React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and modern frontend architectures

- Server-side rendering (SSR), client-side rendering (CSR), and streaming rendering

- Single-page applications (SPA) and Progressive Web Apps (PWA)

- Resource loading, lazy loading, and modern JavaScript bundles

Strong candidates may also have experience with: 

- Building and operating high-throughput content processing pipelines at internet scale

- Distributed systems design and performance optimisation

- Open-source contributions or active involvement in the engineering community

- Conference talks or technical publications

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process. 

Benefits & Perks: 

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius: 

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are looking for an AI Enablement Lead who will architect, scale, and own our AI enablement strategy end-to-end. Cost & Latency Optimization: Actively monitor and manage cloud and API compute spend (token management, open-source vs. commercial models) and optimize execution latency for production AI features.

Standardization of Tooling: Define and enforce the organization's official AI stack, from vector database selection and vector embeddings strategies to semantic caching mechanisms.

- 
Vendor & Open-Source Strategy: Evaluate and manage partnerships with AI model providers and lead the technical assessment of cutting-edge open-source models to keep Actian at the vanguard of innovation.

- 
Data-Driven Impact Tracking: Define and track operational metrics for the AI Enablement function, such as developer adoption rates, reduction in time-to-market for AI features, and ROI of implemented AI tools.

Qualifications & Profile:

- 
Technical Background: Strong background as a Senior AI/ML Engineer, LLMOps Engineer, or Software Architect who has successfully built and scaled AI-powered applications in enterprise SaaS or complex data platforms.

AI & Engineering Mastery: Deep technical expertise in Python or Go, semantic search, vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector), orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), and fine-tuning or prompt engineering of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).

Software Engineering Rigor: You treat AI development as software engineering. You understand CI/CD, unit testing for AI (evaluation datasets), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and clean code architecture.

Influence Without Authority: Exceptional leadership and communication skills. You can inspire and align disparate engineering teams around a shared technical vision without being their direct line manager.

Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills. Ability to demystify complex AI anomalies or architectures into clear business value for internal stakeholders and executives.

Our Product Discovery Experience (PDX) spans two products: FactFinder NG, an exact and highly configurable search, and Infinity, a self-learning, behavioral discovery engine. We're around 90 people with a new management team, a clear growth plan and reknown investors behind us. Right now we're rebuilding our product and tech organization around an AI-first way of working and agentic commerce – and this role sits at the center of it.

Why this role exists

Our two products run two React frontends with very different technical roots. We need a vision, an architect, and an owner — someone who will unify them into a single, efficient system, build the shared design system on top, and enable product managers and designers to prototype and ship production-grade UI themselves with AI tooling. - Create an AI-first prototyping and contribution framework – design system, AI coding tools, guardrails, automated review and CI – so product managers and designers can prototype and contribute production-grade UI

- Work with a clear operating split: after architecture-focused first stints, spend around 80% of your time hands-on coding and 20% on architecture, design-system leadership and enablement

- After 90 days: frontend audit of both products done, target architecture and migration roadmap agreed, design-system tokens and core components live, and the first prototype built and shipped by a product manager or designer on the new framework
- After 12 months: both products run on the shared design system, the frontend rework shows measurable efficiency gains, and product and design prototype independently as a routine – frontend is no longer the bottleneck

- 6+ years in frontend or software engineering, including 3+ years at Staff, Lead or Architect level – setting technical direction across teams, not just within your own
- Hands-on today: you write production code yourself – this is not a concept-only architect position

- Good German language skills

- Change agents with strong opinions, weakly held – able to transform an organization without burning it out
- Enablers who enjoy making product managers and designers productive and treat them as peers
Probably not for you if you'd rather produce architecture concepts than running code, want to go deep on one product and leave the cross-product system to others, or are looking for a people-management role.

THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US What we offer
- Real ownership with executive backing: you shape the frontend of two products end to end. You report to our VP Engineering; our CPTO is the executive sponsor of this role – both agree the target architecture and migration roadmap with you, and the CPTO reviews your 90-day goals and holds your final interview. A company-level priority, not a side project
- AI-first as a leadership priority, with the tooling budget to match: Claude Code, Cursor or whatever makes you fastest

How we hire

location: Newcastle upon Tyne, England, United Kingdom
description:
Who We Are 

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us 

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

This role operates on a hybrid basis and requires attendance in our Newcastle office once a week. While some flexibility may be discussed, applicants should be willing and able to work from the office as part of the role. 

The Role 

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader.

In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed.

The Team You Will Lead 

You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms. 

You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in:

- On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ

- Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments.

- Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused. 

- Cloud environments: GCP and AWS

- Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD)

The Operational Reality 

It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources.

- Context Switching is the Norm

- You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve.

- Agility over Silos

- Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum.

- Focus Management

- Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus; it is for those who thrive on variety, pace, and solving complex problems in real-time.

As the Senior Infrastructure Manager, You Will: 

People Leadership & Talent Development 

- Team Management

- Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of infrastructure engineers. Conduct weekly 1-2-1s, manage performance reviews, and handle all aspects of people management.

- Formal Training & Growth

- Go beyond ad-hoc mentoring to schedule and lead formal training sessions regarding operational improvements. Actively create professional development plans for your direct reports.

- Recruitment & Retention

- Own the hiring process for your team, ensuring we attract top talent and maintain a supportive, inclusive culture.

- Culture of Learning

- Foster a "Self-Learner" mindset. Create a transparent environment where failures are treated as learning opportunities and documented as such for future reference.

Strategic & Operational Management 

- Budget & Capacity Planning

- Ability to own your team's budget and lead capacity planning initiatives. You will forecast future infrastructure needs to ensure we remain scalable while managing spend for subscriptions and hardware.

- Risk & Contingency

- Proactively identify operational risks and form contingency plans immediately to ensure business continuity.

- Procedure & Frameworks

- Ability to define, maintain, and cascade operational procedures (SOPs) and ITIL standards.

- Prioritisation

- Shield your team from noise by effectively prioritising workloads (Changes, Problems, and Projects) and managing stakeholder expectations.

Technical Support & Oversight 

- Performance Optimisation

- Measure and optimise system performance with a focus on improving reliability and time-to-market. You will drive innovation to get ahead of internal customer needs rather than just reacting to them.

- Visual Documentation

- Ensure the team produces detailed system design documentation, specifically enforcing the inclusion of visual representations to support understanding. Ability to technologically assess it as a technical editor.

- Hybrid Estate Management

- Ability to oversee the management of both On-Premise and Cloud (GCP/AWS), ensuring high availability across all environments.

- Unblocking Issues

- Act as the senior escalation point for complex technical issues. Your goal is not to fix the issue yourself, but to coordinate the right resources and provide air cover.

General Duties 

On-Call Duties Willingness to participate in the Management On-Call Rotation to support the department and the business (Current frequency: Once every three weeks). Ad-Hoc Carry out other strategic or technical duties required to support the Director/VP of Technical Operations. 

Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Experience 

Leadership & Management Competencies 

- Proven Management Experience

- Significant experience leading a technical team, with a specific focus on the people management aspect (performance reviews, career growth etc).

- Project Management

- Strong project management experience with the ability to delegate effectively to meet tight deadlines. You must be able to multitask and maintain focus in a high-priority environment.

- Communication

- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be able to liaise effectively with management and other business areas. Engagement may also include interactions with senior technical engineers/leaders within other teams and C-Team members. 

- Goal Oriented

- You must be highly goal-oriented with strict attention to detail, capable of prioritising workload and demand to ensure targets are met.

- ITIL Application / Lean Six Sigma

- Deep knowledge of and experience with ITIL practices, with the ability to apply them to improve team workflows. Demonstrated ability to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts.

Technical Environment & Team Capabilities 

Focusing on the technical skills that your engineers possess, it would be ideal if you had a decent working knowledge of each of the areas. Hands-on expertise in every area is not required, but the ability to hold and facilitate discussions, know when to push or hold back and when to ask poignant questions will help you effectively mentor the team and guide architectural decisions. 

For reference from above these areas are: on-prem and AWS/GCP solutions; system design from network to application level; resilient database availability strategies; automation and configuration management via Ansible, Docker and CI/CD; programming awareness in Python; Linux administration.

Your willingness to learn what you don't know is required to succeed in this role and we will support you through that journey.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills, and Experience 

The following skills or experiences are advantageous but not strictly required. They would be utilised for facilitating tasks rather than for direct, hands-on implementation.

- Innovation & Debt Management

- A keen interest in new technologies and innovation, specifically supporting development teams in the refactoring of technical debt.

- Advanced Containerization

- Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and container ecosystems.

- Observability

- Experience with monitoring systems (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana) and logging stacks (Elasticsearch, Kibana).

- Data Streaming

- Experience with data streaming and queuing technologies, specifically Apache Kafka and Druid.

- Web & Storage

- Knowledge of Nginx (or other web server technologies) and storage technologies like Gluster.

- Tooling

- Proficiency with JIRA and Confluence for project tracking and documentation.

- Version Control

- strong understanding of Git and version control best practices.

Why This Role? 

If you are an experienced technical leader who finds more satisfaction in growing people and building high-performing teams than in closing tickets yourself, this is the role for you. You will have the autonomy to shape the culture of the Infrastructure function and the strategic backing to make a real impact on the business

title: Senior Software Engineer - Distributed Systems (Continuous Profiler)
description:
The Continuous Profiler ( https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/continuous-profiling-fourth-pillar/ ) team at Datadog is building a cutting-edge continuous profiling product that has low enough overhead to run continuously in production, unlocking insights into how customer applications perform under real workloads at scale. As AI reshapes software development and teams lose touch with how their code works and interacts with the hardware, this capability is becoming more essential than ever, for humans and AI alike. Today the information produced by our profilers is used for everything from automatic performance tuning to root cause analysis.

As a distributed systems engineer on the profiling team, you will be contributing to the systems that intake, process, index, store and make sense of the data collected. You will be working with some of the best runtime engineers, visualization experts, data scientists and designers in the industry on challenging and fun problems. Together, we contribute to runtime ecosystems such as Go ( https://opensource.datadoghq.com/projects/go/ ) and tackle novel problems, from profiling asynchronous Python applications ( https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/engineering/async-python-profiler/ ) to helping customers solve memory leaks in their applications ( https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/memory-leak-workflow/) .

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture: the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do: 

● Help design, build and contribute to the core services making the profiling product possible, at a scale that is unusual even within Datadog.

● Participate in multi-disciplinary squads, and iterate with customers, to bring ideas all the way from early explorations to impactful product experiences.

● You will be responsible for your code from development to production, and meet ambitious SLO and quality gates.

● You will be working with many internal and external stakeholders, working on various ways to consume the profiling data, such as the UI, agentic tools, internal applications, integrations and partner products.

Who You Are: 

● Experience with Java and/or Go essential.

● Distributed systems engineer with experience building high performance large scale systems.

● Excellent communication skills (English).

● Ability to meaningfully review architectural proposals and guide technical trade-offs in a complex product space.

● Experience working with AI coding agents to produce performant and maintainable results.

● Experience collaborating with distributed teams.

● Working knowledge of statistical methods, such as sampling strategies, bayesian optimization, sensor fusion etc (nice to have).

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

title: App Developer (Flutter)
description:
At DeWarmte, we make smart, affordable heat pumps that help homes move away from gas. We design the hardware, software and services ourselves, so the quality of our software directly shapes how well our products work in people's homes.

We're growing fast, and both apps need to grow with us. That's why we're looking for an App Developer to build and improve our two Flutter apps. Homeowners use the customer app to control their heat pump. Installers and service engineers use the employee app to install and maintain heat pumps in the field.

You'll spend most of your time writing code: improving quality and reliability and shipping features to iOS and Android. Your work has a direct effect on comfort at home and on how efficiently our installation and service teams work.

AI tools are already part of how we build software. We use them where they help us move faster, but we do not lower the bar: anything we ship still needs to be secure, maintainable and correct. You'll help us get better at both.

Why this role matters 

Build reliable, intuitive apps that give customers confident control of their heat pump and help our installation and service teams do great work in the field.

You'll join the team behind two apps used every day by customers, installers and service engineers. You'll get to know them deeply, keep them reliable and improve them as DeWarmte grows. Just as important: you'll help make sure knowledge and ownership are shared across the team.

What you'll do 

Develop the DeWarmte apps 

- Build the features homeowners and installers to use and control heat pumps 

- Ensure that the DeWarmte apps stand out in the market with regards to usability functionality and innovation. 

- Make sure the app holds up in real-world conditions, like a basement with poor connectivity.

Build a strong app platform 

- Work directly in the production Dart/Flutter codebases for iOS and Android.

- Design, build, test and release new features, from first sketch to the App Store and Google Play.

- Evolve app architecture, state management and shared components across both apps.

- Work with our backend developers on clean, well-documented APIs.

- Improve automated testing, CI/CD, crash reporting, analytics and release practices.

- Diagnose and fix issues that span the apps, our Django backend and devices in the field.

Build with AI 

- Use AI tools to support design, coding, testing, reviews and documentation.

- Help the team improve its AI workflows, shared context and quality checks.

- Try new tools, keep what works and share what you learn.

- Hold AI-assisted code to the same standards as any other production code.

Share ownership 

- Turn implicit knowledge into clear documentation, tooling and repeatable engineering practices.

- Write code that other engineers can easily understand, test and safely change.

- Take part in code reviews and technical decision-making.

Work across the company 

This role reaches beyond app development. You'll work with colleagues in product, backend, hardware, controls, installation and service—and listen closely to customers—to solve today's issues without compromising the apps for tomorrow.

What success looks like 

In your first few months 

- You understand both apps, how they connect to our backend and heat pumps, and where the risks are.

- You can independently build, debug and release changes to both apps through the team's review and release practices.

- The most important technical debt and quality issues are visible and prioritised.

As the role develops 

- New features ship predictably, safely and with good test coverage.

- Customers trust the app to control their heat pump: crash rates go down and app store ratings go up.

- Thanks to the employee app, installations and service visits are faster and have fewer errors.

- The team uses AI tools confidently and responsibly in its day-to-day work.

- Both apps are understood and maintained by more than one person.

Who we're looking for 

- Solid hands-on experience building and shipping production mobile apps with Flutter and Dart.

- Experience releasing and maintaining apps on both the App Store and Google Play.

- A solid grasp of app architecture and state management (e.g. Riverpod, Bloc or Provider).

- Experience integrating REST APIs, authentication and push notifications.

- A track record of taking functionality from design through implementation, testing and release to real-world use.

- Strong engineering fundamentals: version control, automated testing, CI/CD, crash reporting and performance monitoring.

- You use AI coding tools in practice and understand both their value and their limits.

- A feel for user experience and a knack for making complex information simple.

- The ability to bring clarity to an environment where systems and processes are still taking shape.

Experience with native iOS or Android development, offline-first apps, connected devices such as Bluetooth or Wi-Fi provisioning, IoT, energy or HVAC is useful, but not essential. What matters most is that you can learn a complex physical product and take responsibility from idea to release.

How you work 

- You fix urgent problems without letting short-term workarounds become long-term architecture.

- You care about the details users notice, and the ones they don't.

- You're curious about new AI tools, try them quickly and share what works.

- You explain technical topics clearly to people from any background.

- You balance shipping today with the investments needed to scale tomorrow.

- You share knowledge by default and care about what the team can own together.

What we offer 

- A role with direct impact on the apps customers use at home and our teams use in the field.

- The chance to shape both the app platform and the experience around it.

- Room to improve how we use AI tools across the software team.

- A gross monthly salary of [€4,500 – €6,000], based on full-time employment.

- 27 vacation days and 8% holiday allowance.

- The chance to share in DeWarmte's growth through our Stock Appreciation Rights (SAR) programme.

- An ambitious, collaborative team and real responsibility from day one.

- Daily lunch at the office.

- A laptop, access to the AI tools we use and everything else you need to do your best work.

- Regular team activities, including our annual Beach Day and Winter Trip.

- Plenty of room to grow, develop yourself and make a lasting impact.

Interested? 

Want to build the apps that customers and colleagues rely on every day? We'd like to meet you.

Compensation: €4K – €6K per month

This is a hands-on role focused on rapidly prototyping, validating, and shipping product capabilities that make Radiant’s cloud platform easier to use, integrate with, and operate.

Key Responsibilities: 

- Build and prototype product features, workflows, APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling.

- Work closely with Product to turn customer needs into working technical solutions and product experiences.

Qualifications: 

- Strong software engineering experience, ideally in cloud platforms, developer tooling, infrastructure products, or SaaS.

- Good understanding of:

- Cloud infrastructure: compute, storage, networking, containers, Kubernetes

- Comfortable working across the stack where needed, from backend services and integrations to lightweight frontend experiences.

What you bring: 

- Builder mindset: You prefer proving ideas with working software.

- Customer empathy: You understand where developers and operators experience friction.
